title: Using duplicate with DUPLICATE_INTERNAL_STATE causes error "Invalid owner. Owner must be an ancestor in the tree."
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: v4.7.2.stable.official [ed1daf0bf]

### System information

Godot v4.7.2.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6636) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-12900K (24 threads) - 63.75 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

Calling `duplicate(DUPLICATE_INTERNAL_STATE)` on a node will result in error:

> E ... @ _ready(): Invalid owner. Owner must be an ancestor in the tree.
<C++ Error>   Condition "!owner_valid" is true.
<C++ Source>  scene/main/node.cpp:2285 @ set_owner()

Maybe `DUPLICATE_INTERNAL_STATE` doesn't duplicate the parent information but somewhat assumes the duplicate has one?

Anyway, I can *still* add the node to a parent with `add_child` and it will appear in the tree.

demo.gd (provided in MRP below)

```gd
extends Node2D

@onready var node_2d_to_duplicate: Node2D = $Node2DToDuplicate

func _ready() -> void:
	# This is OK
	#var test_duplicate = node_2d_to_duplicate.duplicate()
	#print(test_duplicate.name)

	# This causes error:
	# E 0:00:00:677   demo.gd:14 @ _ready(): Invalid owner. Owner must be an ancestor in the tree.
	#<C++ Error>   Condition "!owner_valid" is true.
	#<C++ Source>  scene/main/node.cpp:2285 @ set_owner()
	var test_duplicate_with_internal_state = node_2d_to_duplicate.duplicate(DUPLICATE_INTERNAL_STATE)

	# Prints "Node2DToDuplicate"
	print(test_duplicate_with_internal_state.name)

	# This still works to add the child in the tree
	add_child(test_duplicate_with_internal_state)

	# Prints "@Node2D@2"
	print(test_duplicate_with_internal_state.name)
```

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open MRP
2. Run the demo scene
3. See error mentioned above

Note: the node can still be added to the tree afterward

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[mrp-duplicate-with-duplicate-internal-state-causes-invalid-owner.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33165818/mrp-duplicate-with-duplicate-internal-state-causes-invalid-owner.zip)
